ordering_and_recovery.stop_first: The task closed and the correction stayed in the draft. Zero saved inputs and zero dispatches.
ordering_and_recovery.terminal_first: The saved final answer closed the task. The unaccepted correction returned to the draft.
ordering_and_recovery.sqlite_full_before_supplement_save: Zero saved or displayed acceptance receipts. The correction returned to the draft.
ordering_and_recovery.kill_before_command_result: One command invocation. Reopening recorded unknown effects and performed no automatic redispatch.
